faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.text: Quick answers about appointments, preparation and this demonstration.

items.title: How do I request an appointment?
items.content: Choose a service and an appointment type, then try the form at the top of this page. It prepares a demonstration request locally; nothing is sent and no real appointment is booked.

items.title: What should I bring to an appointment?
items.content: A real clinic would explain what to bring when confirming your appointment. This sample page does not provide clinical instructions or personalised medical advice.

items.title: Can I choose a family appointment?
items.content: Select “Children and family care” in the service field to see how a family-focused enquiry works. A real clinic would confirm the appropriate appointment and any requirements.

items.title: Are phone appointments available?
items.content: The phone format is included to demonstrate appointment selection. It does not indicate real availability, clinical suitability or an actual service offering.

items.title: Can I change or cancel a request?
items.content: There is no real booking in this demonstration. You can change the selected service or prepare another sample request. No information is stored after you leave the page.
